✨ 很棒的动画工作流程 ✨

用于稳定扩散的简单动画工作流程！

╭🎨 关于此工作流程 🎨╮

-------------------------------

工作流程见解：

  • 选择 v3_sd15_adapter.ckpt作为您的 LoRA 之一以获得最佳性能[链接]

  • 强大的视频抠图建议用于从人物视频中删除背景，为更深入的创意探索奠定基础。

  • 动画输出选项：工作流程产生四个视频输出，提供演示和格式的灵活性。这包括两个 GIF 和两个 MP4，由第一和第二 ksampler 通道分段以实现不同的细节级别。

  • 效率技巧：对于那些希望简化流程的人，请考虑绕过第二遍和/或升级。这些步骤增强了细节，但可以省略以节省时间，而不会显着影响质量。

╭🚀 工作流程细节 🚀╮

-------------------------------

以下是如何充分利用 Awesome Animation Workflow 的方法：

1.初始设置：确保为第二个 ksampler 通道加载 AnimateDiff ControlNet 模型。

2.视频输出说明:

  • 的留下两个视频来自第一个 ksampler 通道；的右二是从第二个开始的。

  • 的前两个视频格式为 GIF，而下二均为 MP4 格式。

  • 至减少滞后，右键单击视频输出并选择“隐藏预览”。

3.行走动画注意事项:

  • 的头发行走动画仅依赖 openpose 来实现无缝 21 帧循环。

  • 的机器人行走动画可以结合 openpose 和可选深度，创建 32 帧循环。可以跳过第 1-24 帧以获得其他视角。

  • 的跳舞视频仅依赖 openpose 来实现（几乎）无缝的 16 帧循环。

╭💡 专业提示 💡╮

----------------------

  • 尝试不同的 LoRA 和设置来发现独特的动画风格。

  • 通过查看两个 ksampler 通道的输出来注意动画的细微差别。

✨ Awesome Animation Workflow ✨

A simple animation workflow for Stable Diffusion!

╭🎨 About This Workflow 🎨╮

-------------------------------

Workflow Insights:

  • Select v3_sd15_adapter.ckptas one of your LoRAs for optimal performance [Link]

  • Robust Video Mattingis recommended for removing backgrounds from videos of human subjects, setting the stage for deeper creative exploration.

  • Animation Output Options: The workflow produces four video outputs, offering flexibility in presentation and format. This includes two GIFs and two MP4s, segmented by the first and second ksampler passes for varied detail levels.

  • Efficiency Tips: For those looking to streamline the process, consider bypassing the second pass and/or upscaling. These steps enhance detail but can be omitted to save time without significantly compromising quality.

╭🚀 Workflow Specifics 🚀╮

-------------------------------

Here's how to make the most out of Awesome Animation Workflow:

1.Initial Setup: Ensure the AnimateDiff ControlNet model is loaded for the second ksampler pass.

2.Video Outputs Explained:

  • Theleft two videosare from the first ksampler pass; theright twoare from the second.

  • Thetop two videosare formatted as GIFs, while thebottom twoare in MP4 format.

  • Toreduce lag, right-click on the video outputs and select "hide preview."

3.Notes on Walking Animations:

  • Thehair walking animationrelies solely on openpose for a seamless 21-frame loop.

  • Therobot walking animationcan incorporate both openpose and optionally depth, creating a 32-frame loop. Frames 1-24 can be skipped for alternative perspectives.

  • Thedancing videorelies solely on openpose for an (almost) seamless 16-frame loop.

╭💡 Pro Tips 💡╮

----------------------

  • Experiment with different LoRAs and settings to discover unique animation styles.

  • Pay attention to the nuances of your animations by reviewing the output from both ksampler passes.
